measurements.detail: club face angle minus club path; + is face open to path (fade shape)
measurements.name: face_to_path_deg

measurements.detail: initial horizontal launch direction; + is right of target
measurements.name: start_line_deg

measurements.detail: carry as printed by the launch monitor; meaningful per club, not across a bag
measurements.name: carry_distance_yds

measurements.detail: carry plus roll as printed; the gap to carry is the ground, not the swing
measurements.name: total_distance_yds

measurements.detail: yards right (+) or left of target the ball started, projected to the carry; not where it finished - the curve is face_to_path_deg
measurements.name: start_line_offline_yds

measurements.detail: ball speed off the face as printed by the launch monitor; a fitting input, judged by nothing
measurements.name: ball_speed_mph

measurements.detail: vertical launch angle as printed; start_line_deg is the horizontal one
measurements.name: launch_angle_deg

measurements.detail: SIMULATED carry from the printed launch conditions; not the launch monitor's own carry, which is carry_distance_yds
measurements.name: flight_carry_yds

measurements.detail: SIMULATED peak height above the tee; the screen prints no apex tile at all
measurements.name: flight_apex_yds

measurements.detail: SIMULATED angle below the horizontal at landing, read off the landing velocity
measurements.name: flight_descent_angle_deg

measurements.detail: SIMULATED hang time from launch to landing
measurements.name: flight_time_s

measurements.detail: SOLVED backspin - the spin this model needs to agree with the printed carry, capped and recorded only when the screen printed none; a printed spin is on the shot, not here
measurements.name: flight_spin_rpm

unscored.detail: no spin axis printed; face-to-path +5.0 deg gives the direction and no magnitude
unscored.name: flight_landing_offline_yds

provenance.note: A direct feed: source mock and no provenance, carrying 2026-08-23-4's printed numbers on the fields devices.json's mock entry declares (club speed, face, path, ball speed, launch, direction, smash, carry, total; no spin, spin axis or apex were printed, and mock declares no shot_type or impact_position). Right-handed, loft 30.5, no photo. tile_refusals gives nothing, because a shot with no provenance was never a photo. Every mock field is analysed, so the view keeps all of them, and no row reads club speed or smash (the M35 plan's finding 7). shot_type is read only to cross-check the curve's direction against the screen's word (InferredSpinAxis::sign_disagrees), which writes no row. So measurements are 2026-08-23-4's recorded shot and flight rows with Python's values, each shot row's source launch_monitor:mock (contracts::capability::device_of: the source's wire name where there is no provenance), and unscored is that vector's flight refusal. shot is the request's, every other key null as a ShotData writes it.
provenance.source: worked by hand in M35 P4, the M35 plan's P4 list; each shot is the named corpus vector's input.shot, edited only as the note says, and Rust's answer (golf_core::run_shot) was checked equal to this expected within RTOL before the file was committed
